thread:
alice: Heads-up: proposing a soft-deprecation notice for nebula2b variants. Need a short model-catalog note, migration guide, and SDK snippet to help users upgrade to nebula3b. Who can own this?

bob: I can take it. Plan: one-paragraph deprecation note, small bench table (latency/quality), migration.md with exact SDK snippets for renaming models and recommended quant profiles, and fix any broken model-card anchors. ETA EOD.

carol: Please add a compatibility note about tokenizer differences — nebula3b uses a new BPE and token counts shift ~+2-4%, which affects max_seq checks. Include an explicit pre-send snippet to detect/tokenize and warn.

bob: Will add Python + JS snippets for token-length check and auto-selecting nebula3b-compat variants when needed. Also adding bench summary: nebula3b +3% accuracy, +12% mean latency on our A100 baseline.

dave: For docs QA, grep for all nebula2b anchors in the catalog and client migration page — I already found 3 broken anchors that need updating.

bob: Fixed anchors and pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1156 — includes deprecation note, migration guide, bench table, code snippets, and anchor fixes.

carol: Quick review: add timeline language (30-day beta, 90-day full deprecation) and a rollback example for private deployments in case customers need more time.

eve: Added rollback CLI steps to the migration playbook and a short reindex note for embeddings. CLI example is tiny and copy-pasteable.

docbot: CI started for PR #1156 	6 running docs-lint, linkcheck, preview build.

docbot: CI passed for PR #1156. Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1156/nebula2b-deprecation.html

alice: LGTM. Merge once one more eng approves so we can announce in #product and ping support.

bob: Merged PR #1156 -> main.

docbot: Publish event: docs update published to production, path: /model-catalog/nebula2b-deprecation.html, timestamp 3529000040

alice: Thanks all  will draft the release note and coordinate the announcement to customers and support.
